facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/run_n.run_video_model_training: run the Timesformer main entry point to train a video classification model using a config file
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/run_n.run_video_model_testing: run the Timesformer main entry point to test a pretrained video classification model using a config file
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/run_n.run_multi_gpu_training: run distributed training across multiple GPUs by setting NUM_GPUS in the config file
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/run_n.run_multi_clip_testing: run multi-clip testing on a pretrained video model by enabling TEST.ENABLE in config
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/run_n.run_tensorboard_visualization: run TensorBoard model visualization by enabling TENSORBOARD.MODEL_VIS in the config file

facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/submi.submit_training_job: submit a multi-GPU training job to a SLURM cluster using submitit executor
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/submi.parse_submit_args: parse command line arguments for GPU count, partition, timeout, and config file path
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/submi.launch_distributed_job: launch distributed training or testing jobs across multiple shards with NCCL initialization
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/submi.setup_trainer_checkpoint: setup a trainer that can checkpoint and resume jobs using submitit delayed submission
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/submi.configure_slurm_executor: configure a submitit AutoExecutor with GPU, memory, and SLURM partition parameters

facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/test_.perform_test_detection: perform fully-convolutional detection testing on full frames without cropping using the model
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/test_.test_with_tensorboard: test the video model with Tensorboard logging enabled for visualization of evaluation metrics
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/test_.save_test_results: save prediction results and labels to a pickle file after running multi-view testing

facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/train.train_video_model: run the train function to train a video classification model for multiple epochs with evaluation

facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/train.evaluate_model: run eval_epoch to evaluate the video model on a validation set and log top1 and top5 errors

facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/train.update_bn_stats: call calculate_and_update_precise_bn to update batch normalization statistics using precise stats from training data

facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/visua.run_visualization: run model visualization to log weights, activations, and video inputs to TensorBoard
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/visua.perform_wrong_prediction_vis: visualize video inputs with wrong model predictions on TensorBoard for analysis
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/visua.visualize: perform layer weights and activations visualization on a SlowFast video model
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/visua.review_run_visualization: review the run_visualization function that registers hooks and logs activations to TensorBoard
facebookresearch_timesformer/tools/visua.refactor_visualize: refactor the visualize function to support a new model architecture or visualization type
